slug: 2024-10-11 South Africa's Significant Improvement in the UN e-Government Index 2024

facts.fact: DCDT says it and SITA jointly developed the National e-Government Portal, hosted by SITA at eservices.gov.za, which gives access to e-Services.
DCDT says the National e-Government Portal currently allows access to 134 e-Services, including licensing, e-recruitment and exam queries, out of 255 services identified for digitisation.
